h1: Custom Safety Jackets for High-Visibility Branding
metaDescription: Order custom safety jackets for your team. High-visibility colors with your logo. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Safety jackets serve a dual purpose: they keep your crew visible on the job site and carry your brand into the field. Choosing a safety color like hi-vis yellow or orange ensures your logo stands out against the high-contrast background, making your company name readable from a distance. These jackets are ideal for construction crews, road workers, and event staff who need both ANSI compliance and professional branding. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery on the chest or back for maximum exposure.
heroAltText: Custom safety jackets in hi-vis yellow with reflective stripes and embroidered logo on chest
